caption: Two people stretch a bungee cord, extending it to its maximum length.
action: pulling two ends of something so that it gets stretched
first_prompt: A single realistic photograph of the initial scene immediately BEFORE the following action begins: Two people stretch a bungee cord, extending it to its maximum length. Show the participants and objects in their starting positions, with enough room for the action. Show one moment only, not a montage, not the completed outcome. No text or diagrams.

clauses.text: Two people must be positioned at opposite ends of the bungee cord to apply tension.
The cord must be stretched until it reaches its maximum elastic extension.
The cord should remain taut and fully extended without snapping or breaking.
The stretching action must be performed gradually to avoid sudden release or loss of control.
